text: How much does it actually cost to get divorced in Australia? Here's a quick guide from Noosa and Hinterland Family Lawyers. The court application fee of eleven hundred dollars must be paid upfront, with a reduced fee of three hundred and sixty-five dollars for eligible people facing financial hardship. Lawyers' professional fees make up the largest portion of divorce costs. Contested divorces typically cost over ten thousand dollars, and cases that go to court can reach fifty to a hundred thousand. Lower-cost options include mediation, fixed-fee services, and consent orders. If you're budgeting for a divorce, our team can help. Speak with Noosa and Hinterland Family Lawyers.
